slug: 2026-06-17 Seacom deploys a new high-capacity Nairobi–Kampala route to strengthen East Africa's digital backbone

systems.tiers: Launched 2026-06-17 inland from Mombasa landing stations; said to give a pathway into neighbouring markets such as Rwanda, but no Rwanda route stated in service

note: Rwanda mentioned only as a neighbouring market the Kenya-Uganda route reaches; no statement that Rwanda traffic runs over it.
